纸上的一个点，要经过一整条成像链。: One printed dot travels through an entire imaging process.
激光照的是感光鼓，纸张走另一条路。: The laser reaches the drum; paper follows a separate path.
先把鼓面充成均匀负电位。: First, give the drum an even negative potential.
曝光改变电位，先写出看不见的图案。: Exposure changes potential, creating an invisible pattern.
带电碳粉把电位图案变成可见图案。: Charged toner makes the electrical pattern visible.
显影取决于各部件之间的电位差。: Development depends on potential differences between components.
转印电场让碳粉离开鼓面，来到纸面。: The transfer field moves toner from drum to paper.
加热软化树脂，压力帮助碳粉黏合纸纤维。: Heat softens toner resin; pressure helps it bond to paper.
清掉残粉与残余电荷，鼓面才可以重新使用。: Remove leftover toner and charge before reusing the drum.
充电 → 曝光 → 显影 → 转印 → 定影。: Charge, expose, develop, transfer, then fuse.
共同节距和表面速度，让各部件配合。: Shared pitch and matched surface speeds coordinate the parts.
激光写电荷，碳粉留图案，定影让它牢固。: Light writes charge; toner forms the image; fusing makes it last.

齿与链节共享同一个节距。: Teeth and links share the same pitch.
前链盘转一圈，拉过与齿数相同数量的链节。: One chainring turn advances one link per tooth.
后轴转速 = 踏频 × 前齿数 ÷ 后齿数。: Rear speed equals cadence times front teeth divided by rear teeth.
相同踏频，小飞轮让后轴转得更多。: At the same cadence, a smaller sprocket turns the axle faster.
同样的链条拉力，小飞轮提供的轴上扭矩更小。: For the same chain pull, a smaller sprocket gives less axle torque.
大飞轮以较低轮速换取更有利的力矩。: A larger rear sprocket trades wheel speed for torque.
坡度增加，维持相同速度需要更大的驱动力。: A steeper road requires more driving force at the same speed.
踏频改变，链速与轮速一起改变。: Changing cadence changes both chain speed and wheel speed.
省力不等于少做相同路程所需的功。: Less pedal force does not erase the work of a climb.
读数表示维持所选踏频所需的力和功率。: The readouts show the effort needed to maintain the selected cadence.
前小后大更轻，前大后小更快。: Smaller front and larger rear favor easier pedaling.
高度先储存能量，松手后开始转化。: Height stores energy that motion can release.
重力沿圆弧方向的分量，把摆球拉向最低点。: The tangential part of gravity pulls the bob toward the bottom.
最低处势能最小，速度最大。: At the bottom, potential energy is lowest and speed is highest.
到达端点，速度降到零，方向反转。: At an endpoint, speed reaches zero before reversing.
从同一位置、同一运动方向回来，才算一周期。: A full period returns to the same position and direction.
摆长增加，周期按平方根关系增大。: Period grows with the square root of length.
理想单摆里，质量改变能量，不改变周期。: In an ideal pendulum, mass changes energy, not period.
重力减弱，相同摆长的钟摆走得更慢。: Weaker gravity makes the same pendulum slower.
大摆幅会偏离小角度周期公式。: Large swings depart from the small-angle period formula.
阻尼把机械能转移给环境。: Damping transfers mechanical energy to the surroundings.
真实摆钟需要补充损耗，并保持稳定的摆动。: A real clock must replace losses and maintain a steady swing.
摆长和重力定节奏，阻尼改振幅，质量改能量尺度。: Length and gravity set the rhythm; damping changes amplitude.

把幅度调回来，残余再次降低。: Matching the amplitudes reduces the residual again.

全部寄存器、内存和有效指令顺序均相同。: Every register, memory value and useful instruction is identical.
只把真正完成的指令记在下方。: The tape records only instructions that have finished.
有效指令 + 填充排空 + 数据停顿 + 分支空位: Useful instructions + fill/drain + data stalls + branch bubbles
工位显示本拍工作；数值是本拍结束后的状态。: Stations show this cycle's work; values show its ending state.
M[0] 等于 11 时分支成立；改成其他数，观察 I7、I8 保留下来。: M[0] = 11 takes the branch. Choose another value to keep I7 and I8.
逐拍推进，检查数据何时可用。: Step through to see when each value becomes available.
打开这份程序与模型约定: Open the program and model assumptions
指令语义参考 RISC-V，使用八个 32 位寄存器。r0 恒为零，分支目标写成: The instruction semantics follow a small RISC-V-like subset: eight 32-bit registers, fixed-zero r0 and instruction IDs for branch targets.
指令与数据存储分开，访存固定一拍；不模拟缓存、异常或乱序执行。: Instruction and data memory are separate. Access takes one cycle. Caches, exceptions and out-of-order execution are omitted.
关闭前递时，译码等待写回；开启时，加载后的紧邻使用仍需一拍停顿。: Without forwarding, decode waits for writeback. With it, an immediate load consumer still stalls for one cycle.
逐条参考也经过五个等长工位，比较不代表真实芯片的频率或性能倍数。: The sequential reference also uses five equal stages. This comparison does not predict a real chip's clock rate or speedup.
I1 从取指走到写回，仍要经过五拍。: I1 takes five cycles from fetch through writeback.
I1 还没完成，I2 已经开始自己的第一步。: I2 starts its first step before I1 has finished.
同一份程序，完成间隔缩短，单条延迟没有缩成一拍。: The same program finishes sooner; one instruction does not shrink to one cycle.
遇到还没写回的值: A value that has not been written
I3 需要 r1 和 r2；关闭前递时，必须等待正确的值。: I3 needs r1 and r2; without forwarding, it must wait for their values.
I3 从两处锁存值取得 4 和 7，在执行级算出 11。: I3 takes 4 and 7 from two pipeline latches and computes 11 in EX.
加载在访存结束才有数据，I5 保持一拍，再接着计算。: The load returns at the end of MEM; I5 waits one cycle, then continues.
分支成立时，清除 I7、I8，从 I9 重新取指。: Taking the branch flushes I7 and I8; fetch resumes at I9.
八条有效指令：流水线 15 拍，逐条参考 40 拍，结果相同。: Eight useful instructions: 15 pipelined cycles, 40 sequential cycles, identical results.
多放一片偏振片，为什么反而透光？: How can adding a polarizer let more light through?
两片变暗，三片透光。: Two filters go dark. Three let light through.
跟随电场穿过三片滤光片，连接偏振方向、马吕斯定律与每一步的能量去向。: Follow an electric field through three filters to connect polarization, Malus’s law, and the energy removed at each step.
光沿同一条轴传播，电场在垂直于光路的平面内振动。输出光强为入射的 {0}。: Light travels along one axis; its electric field oscillates in the transverse plane. The output intensity is {0} of the input.
交叉外片之间，中间轴为 45° 时透光最多。: Between crossed outer filters, a 45° middle axis gives maximum transmission.
马吕斯曲线：相对透过率等于夹角余弦的平方。: Malus’s curve: relative transmission is the squared cosine of the angle.
每片都只留下当前电场的投影。: Each filter keeps a projection of the arriving field.
拖动圆环，或用方向键微调。: Turn the dial, or fine-tune with arrow keys.
波线是电场示意，不是光的弯曲路线。光始终沿中心轴前进；振动和传播都已放慢，磁场省: The waves represent the electric field, not a curved route taken by light. Light travels along the central axis. Oscillation and propagation are slowed; the magnetic field is omitted.
迎光圆图显示横向电场：非偏振时的多条轴表示时间统计，固定长度的箭头表示均方根振幅: The end-on circle shows the transverse field. Multiple axes represent unpolarized time statistics; fixed-length arrows show RMS amplitudes. Intensity is a time average proportional to squared field amplitude.
本模型使用理想、完全覆盖光束的吸收型偏振片；未透过的能量计入吸收。真实滤片还会有: These ideal absorbing polarizers cover the whole beam. Untransmitted energy is counted as absorption. Real filters can also reflect, leak, and introduce additional losses.
光沿轴向前，电场在横向振动。: Light travels along the axis; its electric field oscillates across it.
非偏振光的电场方向随时间变化，没有固定优先轴。: Unpolarized light has no persistent preferred electric-field axis.
理想第一片转到任何方向，都透过非偏振入射的一半。: The first ideal polarizer passes half of unpolarized input at any angle.
第二片的透过率，取决于两轴夹角的余弦平方。: The second filter transmits the squared cosine of the angle between the axes.
两轴相差 90°，末片没有可透过的电场分量。: At 90°, no component of the arriving field passes the final filter.
中间轴转向 45°，交叉外片后重新透出 12.5%。: Turning the middle axis to 45° restores 12.5% transmission through crossed outer filters.
外片保持交叉，中间轴在 45° 时给出最大输出。: With crossed outer filters, the middle axis gives maximum output at 45°.
一年的几何日积分: Daily geometric input through the year
一米立杆的日影与地平线上方的太阳轨迹: A one-metre post, its shadow, and the Sun’s path above the horizon
两个纬圈的几何白昼时长: Geometric daylight duration at opposite latitudes
光束截面图在很低的太阳高度截断超出画幅的光斑；精确入射比例仍来自模型。: At very low Sun heights, the beam diagram clips footprints outside its frame; the input fraction remains exact.
几何入射量，不代表气温或天气。: Incoming geometry, not temperature or weather.
南北半球的全年入射量，虚线为零倾角: Annual geometric input at opposite latitudes; the dashed line shows zero tilt
南北纬圈的一日入射曲线，竖线是当前太阳时: Daily input at opposite latitudes; the vertical line marks local solar time
同一宽度的平行光束在水平面上铺开的长度: The horizontal footprint of a parallel beam with constant width
同一束光，铺开多大？: How far does one beam spread?
圆轨道、平行阳光、几何地平线；忽略大气折射与太阳圆面大小。分点的极点另作地平线边: Circular orbit, parallel sunlight and a geometric horizon. Refraction and the Sun’s disk size are omitted. Exact poles at an equinox have a separate horizon state.
圆轨道中的固定地轴与四个季节点: A fixed axis on a circular orbit, with equinox and solstice positions
地球上的昼夜分界、观测纬圈与当前地点: Earth’s day–night boundary, observing latitudes and the current site
地轴的方向留在空间里: An axis that keeps its direction
太阳中心停在地平线: The Sun’s centre is on the horizon
太阳在地平线下: The Sun is below the horizon
太阳黄经（从三月分点起）: Solar longitude from the March equinox
影子超出刻度盘；读数保留完整长度。: The shadow extends off the plate; the reading gives its full length.
日积分 / S₀ 表示把入射比例累加一天，单位是等效正入射小时。这里没有大气、地: Daily input / S₀ integrates the input fraction over a day, in equivalent hours of perpendicular illumination. Atmosphere, surface absorption, heat storage and weather are not calculated.
模型约定与读图方法: Model conventions and reading the instruments
球面金色点与立杆是同一观测位置。虚线表示球体背面的纬圈；近景相机跟随日照方向，轨: The gold globe marker and the post are the same observing site. Dashed latitude lines lie on the far side. The close-up follows sunlight; the orbit plate keeps a fixed orientation in space.
轨道为倾斜视图；地球尺寸放大。: The orbit is viewed obliquely; Earth is enlarged.
金线间的垂直宽度相同；地面接收面积随角度改变。: The beam’s perpendicular width stays fixed; its ground footprint changes with angle.
地轴一倾斜，为什么就有了四季？: How does a tilted axis create the seasons?
跟随一根影子，读懂两半球的季节。: Follow one shadow through the seasons of two hemispheres.
从太阳高度、白昼长短与日影出发，连接地轴倾斜、分至点、极昼极夜和零倾角对照。: Connect axial tilt, equinoxes, solstices and polar day through Sun height, daylight, shadows and a zero-tilt comparison.
同一纬度的南北两地，白昼长短在半年后交换。: At opposite latitudes, long and short days swap after half an orbit.
地球沿圆轨道前进，地轴在空间中的方向保持不变。: Earth follows its orbit while the axis keeps the same direction in space.
太阳越低，同一束光铺得越开，单位水平面积入射越少。: A lower Sun spreads the same beam across more horizontal area.
白昼越长，水平面接收阳光的时间就越长。: A longer day gives the horizontal surface more time to receive sunlight.
分点时太阳赤纬为零；非极点地区的几何昼夜各占一半。: At an equinox, zero declination divides geometric day and night equally away from the poles.
越过极圈，太阳可以全天不落，也可以全天不升。: Beyond the polar circle, the Sun can stay above or below the horizon all day.
零倾角的圆轨道中，同一纬度的日照几何全年不变。: With zero tilt and a circular orbit, the daily geometry at a fixed latitude stays the same all year.
太阳高度与白昼时长决定几何入射；气温还需要热量收支。: Sun height and daylight determine geometric input; temperature also needs an energy balance.
跟住一颗球，看清两处接触。: Follow one ball through two contacts.
转一圈，停在任意接触位置: Turn, then stop at any contact
单列径向轴承，接触角为零；内圈驱动、外圈固定。宏观几何采用刚性球、理想无滑动和零: A single-row radial bearing with zero contact angle, a driven inner ring and fixed outer ring. The overall geometry uses rigid balls, ideal no-slip rolling and zero radial clearance. Balls are tangent to circular race grooves; cage pockets have clearance.
承载亮度采用 max(0, cos θ)^(3/2) 的教学权重；θ 是球相对载: Load brightness uses the teaching weight max(0, cos θ)^(3/2), where θ measures a ball from the imposed load direction. It does not solve actual contact-force equilibrium.
真实轴承有弹性、游隙、润滑和局部滑动。接触斑与润滑膜被夸大；本演示不预测摩擦系数: Real bearings have elasticity, clearance, lubrication and local slip. Contact patches and lubricant films are exaggerated; no friction coefficient, temperature rise, life or load rating is predicted. The cage is a simplified ball-guided crown design.
承载区不跟着球转: Balls pass through a fixed load zone
轴向剖面：滚道是圆弧，球面与内外圈相切: Axial section: circular race grooves tangent to the ball
禁用自转的对照：两处接触都产生滑动: Constrained no-spin comparison: sliding at both contacts
跟随球心的局部视图；速度箭头仍以固定外圈为参考: Detail follows the ball center; velocity arrows remain relative to the fixed outer ring
接触式密封剖面示意，主装配未安装密封: Illustrative contact-seal section; the main assembly has no seal
接触斑与润滑膜的定性放大图，不按比例: Qualitative magnification of contact patch and lubricant film, not to scale
弹性形变本身不等于全部损耗；真实材料和接触过程可能耗散能量。: Elastic deformation alone is not a loss calculation; real material and contact processes can dissipate energy.
有限接触斑内，名义滚动仍可伴随局部滑动。: Nominal rolling can include local sliding within a finite contact patch.
润滑有助于分隔表面，同时也产生流动阻力。: Lubrication helps separate surfaces and also introduces flow resistance.
若装有接触式密封，密封唇与旋转表面之间也有滑动。: When fitted, contact seals add sliding between the seal lip and the rotating surface.
外侧：v/2 − v/2 = 0。内侧：v/2 + v/2 = v。: Outside: v/2 − v/2 = 0. Inside: v/2 + v/2 = v.
球心都以 v/2 前进；禁止自转时，两边都对不上表面速度。: Both centers travel at v/2. Preventing spin creates a speed mismatch at both contacts.
教学假设：载荷方向固定，亮度仅表示相对权重，不是牛顿值。: Teaching assumption: fixed load direction. Brightness is a relative weight, not newtons.
几何接触点，承载后成为有限接触斑。此处只示意，不计算接触应力。: A geometric point becomes a finite contact patch under load. This is qualitative, with no contact-stress calculation.
二维轴承剖面：金色球沿同心滚道公转，同时反向自转: 2D bearing section: the gold ball orbits concentric races while spinning in the opposite direction
滚珠轴承剖视：轴、内外圈、球面保持架兜孔和固定支座: Bearing cutaway: shaft, inner and outer races, spherical cage pockets and fixed housing
一颗滚珠，怎样让转轴轻快地转动？: How does a ball help a shaft turn freely?
跟随一颗球穿过承载区，从无滑动几何推导保持架与自转，再放大真实接触中的损耗。: Follow a ball through the load zone, derive cage motion and spin from no-slip geometry, then inspect real contact losses.
轴、内圈、滚珠、外圈、支座，组成连续的承载路径。: Shaft, inner ring, balls, outer ring and housing form a connected load path.
球心前进与球的自转相加或抵消，分别跟上两条滚道。: Translation and spin add at one contact and cancel at the other.
保持架跟随球心；球相对固定支座反向自转。: The cage follows the centers; each ball spins oppositely in the fixed frame.
人为禁止自转后，相同的球心速度会在两处接触产生滑动。: Preventing spin creates slip at both contacts, even with the same center speed.
同一颗球，轮流承载: One ball enters the load zone
载荷方向固定；金色球进入亮区承载，离开后卸载。: The load direction stays fixed while the gold ball enters and leaves the loaded region.
真实承载会形成有限接触斑；放大图不表示真实尺寸。: Real loading produces a finite contact patch; this enlargement is not to scale.
真实接触、局部滑动、润滑和可选的接触密封，都可能贡献损耗。: Real contact, local slip, lubricant and optional contact seals can contribute losses.
滚珠协调两处接触，在支撑转轴的同时减少持续的宏观滑动。: Coordinated rolling supports the shaft while reducing sustained macroscopic sliding.
水为什么能先爬高，再流向低处？: How can water climb before flowing downhill?
水柱连通，落差才有路可走。: A continuous column gives the drop a path.
跟随透明弯管里的水，连接预充、水头、压力分布、进气断流与顶部高度的边界。: Follow water through a transparent tube to connect priming, head, pressure, air breaks and crest-height limits.
流体 · 水头与连续液柱: Fluids · head and the continuous column
落差还在，水柱已断: The drop remains; the column is broken
低处的出口提供落差: The lower outlet creates the drop
顶部仍有空气，虹吸尚未建立。: Air remains at the crest. The siphon has not started.
预充在排出空气，还需要外部做功。: Priming removes air and requires external work.
水柱连通，落差正在驱动流动。: The column is continuous; the head difference drives flow.
顶部进气，连续液柱已经断开。: Air entering the crest interrupts the liquid column.
顶部压力达到汽化边界，连续液柱解失效。: The crest reaches the vapor boundary. The continuous-column solution fails.
入口露出水面，空气进入管路。: The inlet emerges and lets air into the tube.
各高度重新预充；气泡只标记模型失效，不模拟两相流。: Each height is prefilled separately. Bubbles mark model failure; two-phase flow is not simulated.
改变条件会从同一总水量重算一次实验。拖动实验时间，观察真实排水与水位变化。: Changing a setting restarts a trial with the same total water. Scrub trial time to see calculated transfer and changing levels.
转动出口会换回短管装置。: Rotating the outlet returns to the short tube.
这套流体模型怎样计算？: How is this fluid model calculated?
自由出流、等截面、准稳态；不预测启动惯性、水锤或气泡动力学。水面速度忽略。: Free outlet, constant bore, quasi-steady flow. Startup inertia, water hammer and bubble dynamics are omitted, as is reservoir-surface speed.
作者设定：内径 12 mm，达西摩阻系数 0.03，入口损失 0.5，弯管损失: Authored values: 12 mm bore, Darcy friction factor 0.03, entrance loss 0.5 and bend loss 0.4. The drawn bore is enlarged.
预充和进气排空采用指定的教学进度，分段水量仍逐项守恒；汽化后不再把单相流量当作真: Priming and drainage use prescribed teaching progress while accounting for every water volume. The single-phase flow output stops at the vapor boundary.
管内亮点是减速显示的示踪标记；间距表示同一截面的连续流动，不是水分子的真实间距。: The dots are slowed tracers of continuous flow through a constant bore. They do not represent molecular spacing.
自由出口与淹没出口的水头不同: Free and submerged exits use different heads
虹吸装置：水源、连续弯管与接水容器，水位由体积守恒计算。: Siphon apparatus: source, continuous bent tube and receiving vessel. Water levels follow volume conservation.
沿管压力先下降，在下行段恢复；出口回到大气压。: Pressure falls along the ascent, recovers on the descent, and returns to ambient at the outlet.
空管不会自己启动: An empty tube does not start
顶部有空气，低出口也还不能形成虹吸。: A low outlet is not enough while air interrupts the crest.
预充器先做功；水柱连通后，落差接手。: The primer supplies work first; the head difference then sustains flow.
上升段爬高，整条水路却向更低处输水。: One leg climbs, but the complete journey ends lower.
顶部为什么低压: Why pressure falls at the crest
压力与高度一起变化；自由出口回到环境压力。: Pressure changes with elevation and returns to ambient at the free outlet.
把出口抬到水面: Raise the outlet to the surface
管长没有改变；落差减小，持续流量归零。: Tube length is unchanged. Less head brings the sustained flow to zero.
低出口仍在，进气却切断了连续液柱。: The outlet is still low, but admitted air breaks the column.
顶部不能无限升高: The crest has a pressure limit
普通水的顶部压力接近蒸气压时，单相水柱模型失效。: For ordinary water, approaching vapor pressure invalidates the single-phase column.
相同大气压不增加驱动水头，却改变水柱能保持的高度。: Equal ambient pressures add no driving head, but change the column’s feasible height.
出口不低于水面，持续流量归零。: At or above the source surface, the outlet cannot sustain forward flow.
转动一圈铜线，为什么会发电？: Why does a turning loop generate electricity?
电流出现时，为什么轴更难转？: Why does the shaft resist turning when current flows?
追踪旋转线圈、滑环与电刷，把磁通变化、交流电压、反向力矩和机械能转换接起来。: Follow a rotating loop, slip rings and brushes to connect changing flux, AC voltage, opposing torque and mechanical energy conversion.
沿轴看两只滑环: Two rings, viewed along the shaft
铜线接点在转；电刷不转: Wire joints rotate; brushes stay still
两个滑环分别保持 A 与 B 接通，没有每半圈交换端子: Each ring keeps its own A or B connection; terminals do not swap every half turn
完整滑环保持原来的接线，所以输出仍会正负交替。: Continuous rings preserve the connections, so output polarity still alternates.
一圈留下的电压: The voltage traced by one turn
机械功等于负载得到的电能与内部损耗: Shaft work equals energy delivered to the load plus internal loss
旋转角度与带正负号的端电压: Rotor angle and signed terminal voltage
一圈铜线，接住转动: A copper loop catches the turn
没有电流，就没有这里的电磁阻力矩: With no current, there is no electromagnetic drag here
法线与磁场的夹角，决定穿过线圈的磁通: The angle between the normal and field determines the linked flux
磁场不提供持续能量，驱动轴才提供机械功: The driving shaft supplies work; the field is not a continuing energy source
正角度绕轴的正方向增加；初始线圈法线与气隙磁场平行。电压定义为 B 电刷减去 A: Positive angle increases about the positive shaft axis. The initial loop normal is parallel to the gap field. Voltage is brush B minus brush A; positive current leaves B, crosses the load and returns to A.
这是一个单匝、圆角矩形线圈。面积由铜线中心线推导；转轴、绝缘支架、滑环和电刷分开: This is one rounded rectangular turn, with area derived from its conductor centerline. The shaft, insulating supports, rings and brushes have separate connections. The gap field is uniform; fringing and extra induction in rotating leads are neglected.
影片使用慢动作和观察停帧；转角滑块改变取样位置，转速滑块改变真实计算。由外部驱动: The film uses slow motion and observation holds. Angle selects a sample; speed changes the physical calculation. An external drive sets speed. Rotor inertia, bearing friction, coil inductance and armature reaction are omitted.
内部等效电阻为 0.4 Ω，合并绕组与电刷接触损耗，不计算温度。负载开路时只有感: An internal equivalent resistance of 0.4 Ω combines winding and brush-contact losses; temperature is not calculated. With the load open, induced voltage can exist without output power or electromagnetic braking torque.
单匝发电机：铜线圈随轴旋转，两只完整滑环接触固定电刷: Single-turn generator: the copper loop rotates with the shaft; two continuous slip rings touch stationary brushes
发电机二维轴测图：旋转铜环、完整滑环与固定电刷保持连接: Generator axonometric section: the rotating copper loop remains connected through continuous rings and stationary brushes
磁场存在还不够；转动线圈，才让磁通随时间改变。: A field alone is not enough; rotation makes the linked flux change.

每圈代表一个波峰；时间单位为发射周期 T₀，距离单位为 cT₀。这里只画三维球面: Each circle marks a crest. Time is measured in emission periods T₀, distance in cT₀. These are planar sections of spherical fronts, without pressure, loudness or air-particle motion.

读数是相邻两次到达的平均频率。离轴经过时，接连几段间隔会逐渐改变；金线对应此刻抵: The readout averages frequency between two adjacent arrivals. During an off-axis pass, successive intervals change gradually. The gold line traces the phase arriving now to its earlier emission position.
速度保持恒定，空气均匀且无风；忽略反射、吸收和色散。控制范围低于声速；恰好达到声: Velocities are constant in uniform, still air. Reflection, absorption and dispersion are omitted. Controls stay below the sound speed. Exactly sonic and supersonic inputs are rejected; shock waves and light Doppler shifts require different models.
波圈以各自发射点为圆心，接收者与波圈相交时收到波峰。: Each circle is centered at its emission point. A crest arrives when its circle meets the receiver.
共用时间轴：上排等间隔发射，下排按真实传播时间记录到达。: A shared time axis: equally spaced emissions above, arrivals solved from travel time below.
双方静止时，传播只推迟到达，不改变间隔。: With both bodies still, propagation delays arrivals without changing their spacing.
声源移走后，每一圈仍以发射时的位置为圆心。: After the source moves on, each circle stays centered at its emission position.
前方波长缩短；源频率不变，接收频率升高。: The forward wavelength shrinks. Emission frequency stays fixed; reception frequency rises.

出口重新变宽，理想无损流的压力随之恢复。: The wider outlet slows the flow and recovers pressure in the lossless model.
截面相同、速度相同；抬高出口，压力仍会降低。: Same area, same speed: raising the outlet still reduces pressure.
流量为零时，水柱液面等高，局部压力仍随高程改变。: With zero flow, column surfaces align while local pressure varies with elevation.
加入明确计算的沿程损失，出口不能恢复全部压力。: Calculated distributed loss prevents complete pressure recovery.

所请求稳态已触及蒸气压；画面停在液态边界。: The requested state reaches vapor pressure. The display stops at the liquid boundary.
不继续外推汽化、气泡或两相流。: Vapor, bubbles and two-phase flow are not extrapolated.
各帧为独立稳态，不模拟改变装置的瞬态。: Each frame is a separate steady state; apparatus changes are not transient simulations.

主图管径放大示意，水柱与高程共用高度标尺。: Bore size is enlarged. Column surfaces and elevation share one height scale.
稳态、不可压缩、单根圆管；截面平均速度，动能修正系数取 1。入口流量与绝对压力由: One steady incompressible flow in a circular tube; section-mean velocity and kinetic correction factor 1. External equipment prescribes inlet flow and absolute pressure; the model determines outlet pressure.
无损时沿同一流线：p/ρg + v²/2g + z = H。损失对照使用 hL: Without loss, p/ρg + v²/2g + z = H along a streamline. The loss comparison uses hL = ∫ f v²/(2gD) ds with an authored f, not measured data or an automatic turbulence prediction.
管长 1.8 m，入口内径 60 mm，默认面积比 0.36；水密度 998.2: Length 1.8 m, inlet bore 60 mm, default area ratio 0.36; water density 998.2 kg/m³. Separation, local losses, radial velocity profiles, measuring-tube storage and surface oscillations are omitted.
水体运动按规定流量计算，再放慢播放；物理时间读数保持真实单位。: Material motion follows the prescribed flow and is slowed for viewing. The physical clock retains real units.
只接受非负规定流量；反向流、空管和两相流不在模型内。20 °C 蒸气压取 233: Only nonnegative prescribed flow is supported. Reverse flow, empty tubes and two-phase flow are excluded. Vapor pressure at 20 °C is set to 2338 Pa; the display stops at the limiting steady state.

把四位数据织进七个位: Weave four data bits into seven positions

发送和接收按相同位编号对齐，先观察没有错误的情况。: Align sent and received positions. First, observe a channel with no flips.
接收端重新检查：偶数个 1 得 0，奇数个 1 得 1。: Recheck the received word: an even count of ones gives 0; odd gives 1.
C4、C2、C1 得到 110₂ = 6；假定只有单错，位置就是 6。: C4, C2, C1 give 110₂ = 6. Assuming one error, its position is 6.
翻回第 6 位，三项校验归零；提取原来的四个数据位置。: Flip position 6 back. All checks return to zero; extract the four data positions.
综合征定位 6；纠错前先保留接收到的码字。: The syndrome points to 6. Hold the received word before correcting it.
先保留发送码字，接下来同时翻转第 3、5 位。: Start from the sent word. Next, flip positions 3 and 5 together.
误翻第 6 位后，校验全通过，数据却错了。普通解码器无法分辨。: After wrongly flipping 6, every check passes but the data is wrong. The plain decoder cannot tell.
第 3、5 位同时翻转，也给出 110₂；它与单错 6 的指纹相同。: Flips at 3 and 5 also give 110₂, the same signature as a single flip at 6.
相同双错：综合征非零，总奇偶仍为偶。报警，并且不交付数据。: Same two flips: nonzero syndrome, even overall parity. Flag the error; withhold the data.
第 8 位检查全部八个位，使整字中 1 的数量为偶数。: Position 8 checks all eight bits, making the overall count of ones even.
以下判断以最多两位翻转为前提；三位及以上可能误纠或漏检。: These decisions assume at most two flips. Three or more may be miscorrected or missed.
数据位置保留原值: Data positions keep their original values
每条线只数自己的四个位: Each loop counts only its four bits
P1、P2、P4 补足偶数个 1。: P1, P2 and P4 make each count even.
参加 C2 和 C4，但不参加 C1：只有位置 6。: In C2 and C4 but outside C1: only position 6.
亲手翻转，同一套解码规则: Your flips, the same decoding rules
选择数据与位编号；解码器只能看到接收码字。: Choose data and flip positions. The decoder sees only the received word.
已超出两位错误的保证范围；此时接受或纠正都可能得到错误数据。: Beyond the two-error guarantee: accepting or correcting may now deliver wrong data.
普通 Hamming 直接按非零综合征翻位；无法同时纠正单错并识别双错。: Plain Hamming flips the position given by a nonzero syndrome. It cannot both correct single errors and distinguish double errors.
位编号标明位置；格内的 0、1 才是数据值。: Numbers mark positions; the 0 or 1 inside is the bit value.
单错可纠正，双错须扩展码检测；更多错误不保证。: Correct one error; detect two with the extended code. More errors carry no guarantee.
四个数据位保留原值，三个校验位补足偶校验。: Four data bits stay intact; three check bits make each group even.
重叠形成位置指纹: Overlap gives each position a signature
每个位参加不同的校验组合；位置 6 属于 C2、C4，不属于 C1。: Each position has a different check signature; position 6 belongs to C2 and C4, but not C1.
先对齐相同位编号，再让信道只翻转第 6 位。: Align the same positions, then let the channel flip only position 6.
把校验结果读成位置: Read the syndrome as a position
C4、C2、C1 的结果是 110₂ = 6；单错假设下定位第 6 位。: C4, C2, C1 read 110₂ = 6, locating position 6 under the single-error assumption.
只翻回第 6 位，校验归零，四位数据恢复为 1011。: Flip only position 6 back; checks return to zero and the data returns to 1011.
翻转 3、5 位也产生综合征 6；再翻 6 会通过校验，却交付错误数据。: Flips at 3 and 5 also produce syndrome 6; flipping 6 then passes the checks but delivers wrong data.
加上全字的奇偶检查: Add a check across the whole word
相同双错下，s 非零而 q 为零；扩展码检出双错，拒绝误纠。: For the same double error, s is nonzero and q is zero; the extended code detects it and refuses to correct.
在最多两位翻转的前提下区分四种情况；更多错误没有同样保证。: Distinguish four cases under an at-most-two-flip assumption; larger errors carry no such guarantee.

等大半轴齿轮各 24 齿，行星齿轮各 16 齿。节锥角由齿数比决定，所有节锥共顶: The equal side gears have 24 teeth each and the pinions 16. Tooth counts determine the pitch-cone angles; all cones share one apex. 壳体通过四根桥和中央支承环连接十字轴。半轴插入各自齿轮的孔内，在交叉轴之前终止；: Four bridges and a central support ring connect the carrier to the cross pin. Each half-shaft enters its own gear bore and ends before the crossing pin. A separate torque model specifies tire-reaction limits and neglects friction, inertia and losses; its bars do not predict slip speed. Locking, limited-slip and electronic brake control are absent.

从分层体模的真实延迟回波出发，理解反射与透射、RF 和包络、B 模式扫描、轴向分: Follow calculated echoes from a layered phantom to understand reflection, transmission, RF and envelopes, B-mode scanning, axial resolution, attenuation shadows and depth errors from an assumed sound speed.
发射的是一小段振动；同一个探头随后接收回波。: The probe sends a short vibration, then receives the returning echoes.
回波走了一个来回：深度等于声速乘以时间，再除以二。: An echo makes a return trip: depth is sound speed times delay, divided by two.
界面只反射一部分能量，其余继续传播，产生更深处的回波。: A boundary reflects part of the energy; the rest travels on to produce deeper echoes.
反射可以翻转 RF 的符号；显示亮度用的是非负包络。: Reflection can reverse the RF sign. Display brightness uses a nonnegative envelope.
探头换一个位置，就添一列真实计算的回波亮度。: Each probe position adds a column of brightness calculated from its echoes.
两界面相隔 0.64 mm；短脉冲让这组重叠回波分开。: The faces are 0.64 mm apart. A shorter pulse separates these overlapping echoes.
嵌块前表面的回波不变，后方回波因往返衰减而变暗。: The insert’s front echo stays fixed; deeper echoes darken with two-way attenuation.
回波时刻没有变；改正假定声速，界面才回到正确深度。: Echo timing stays fixed. Correcting the assumed speed restores the true depth.
56 mm 界面的显示深度: Displayed depth of the 56 mm face
以发射包络中心为零时刻；方向键、Home 和 End 可调节。: Zero is the transmitted envelope center. Adjust with arrow keys, Home and End.
每个位置只计算一条垂直声线，探头停驻后发射和接收。界面均按法向入射处理，忽略列间: Each stationary probe position uses one vertical ray. All interfaces use normal incidence. Propagation between columns, vertical sidewalls, diffraction, refraction, beamforming, speckle and multiple reflections are omitted.
体模的压强反射系数为 r=(Z₂−Z₁)/(Z₂+Z₁)。回波包含去程与回程的透: Pressure reflection is r=(Z₂−Z₁)/(Z₂+Z₁). Echoes include transmission on both legs. Attenuation is evaluated at the center frequency and held constant across the pulse bandwidth.
背景衰减为 0.35 dB/(cm·MHz)，嵌块再加上滑块设定值。包络用理想相: Background attenuation is 0.35 dB/(cm·MHz), plus the chosen extra loss in the insert. The envelope is the magnitude of ideal coherent quadratures. Brightness uses a fixed pressure reference of 0.25 and a 45 dB range, without per-column automatic gain.
cτ/2 表示有限脉冲支撑长度的一半，是本实验的分离尺度；实际可辨程度还取决于包: cτ/2 is half the pulse’s spatial support and gives a separation scale here. Discrimination also depends on envelope, phase, bandwidth and noise. This phantom is not human anatomy; probe matching and coupling layers illustrate ideal contact.
已知体模与探头：脉冲按真实传播时刻经过界面并返回。: Known phantom and probe: pulses cross interfaces and return at calculated travel times.
发射的有限脉冲：载波位于一个有起止的包络内。: The finite transmitted pulse: a carrier within an envelope that starts and ends.
A 线：按真实到达时刻排列的有符号 RF 回波。: A-line: signed RF echoes at their actual arrival times.
两次回波按中心对齐：RF 极性相反，包络都为非负。: Two center-aligned echoes: opposite RF polarity, nonnegative envelopes.
同一薄片的长短脉冲回波：缩短包络，使相邻界面的两个峰分开。: Long and short pulse returns from the same foil: a shorter envelope separates the two interface peaks.
B 模式扫描：每列来自同一体模的一条回波记录，灰度由包络计算。: B-mode scan: each column comes from an echo record of the same phantom, with gray levels calculated from its envelope.
有限脉冲离开探头，随后沿原声线返回。: A finite pulse leaves the probe and later returns along the same ray.

这是对称 Joukowski 翼型的二维、稳态、不可压缩势流。观察窗不是带实体壁: This is steady, two-dimensional, incompressible potential flow around a symmetric Joukowski section. The observation window has no modeled tunnel walls; the mathematical flow domain extends to infinity.
先满足远处来流、表面不穿透与 Kutta 尾缘条件，再由速度计算 Cp = 1: First satisfy the distant wind, surface impermeability and the Kutta condition. Then calculate Cp = 1 − (v/U∞)² and pressure from velocity. Bernoulli alone cannot select the velocity field.
弦长 1 m，空气密度 1.225 kg/m³，环境绝对压力 101325 Pa: The chord is 1 m, density 1.225 kg/m³ and ambient absolute pressure 101325 Pa. N/m means force per unit span. This small-incidence, low-speed demonstration does not predict stall angle, separation, friction drag or finite-span induced drag.
表面载荷减去了均匀环境压力；这一常量在闭合表面的总积分为零。蓝色低压表示较少的向: Surface loads subtract uniform ambient pressure, whose net integral around the closed surface is zero. Blue low pressure means less inward push; arrows show the increment relative to ambient.
环量由 Kutta 条件选定；真实流动建立这一环量涉及黏性和起动过程，本模型没有: The Kutta condition selects circulation. Establishing it in real flow involves viscosity and startup, which are not simulated. Zero ideal two-dimensional pressure drag does not mean real wings have no drag.
物体内部、映射极点和精确尾缘不直接求速度；尾缘另用解析极限检验。空气示踪以同一速: Velocity is not evaluated inside the solid, at the mapping pole or at the exact cusp. An analytic limit checks the trailing edge. Fourth-order integration of the same field reconstructs tracer positions at any requested time.
解析速度场中的对称翼型；表面颜色与压力、轨迹与速度、合力与整圈积分一致。: A symmetric airfoil in an analytic velocity field. Surface colors encode pressure, paths follow velocity, and the resultant sums the whole surface.

采用空气中、低孔径的标量近轴模型：NA≈r/u，最高约 0.24。精确 NA 是: This is a low-aperture scalar paraxial model in air: NA≈r/u, up to about 0.24. Exact NA is sin(arctan(r/u)); the difference here is below 3%. Do not extrapolate it to high-NA or oil-immersion objectives.
荧光点彼此不相干，各点强度相加。点像由同一圆形孔径的 Fresnel 积分计算；: The fluorescent points are mutually incoherent, so their intensities add. Point images use a Fresnel integral over the same circular pupil, referenced to the in-focus single-point peak. Throughput, noise, fluorescence chemistry and partially coherent illumination are not simulated.

在封闭格子里计算温度、浮力与流动，追踪热量怎样被携带。: Compute temperature, buoyancy and flow in a closed cell, and follow how moving fluid carries heat.
没有流动，热也会扩散；完全对称的初态不会凭空长出涡旋。: Heat diffuses without flow. An exactly symmetric initial state does not invent a vortex.
重置为导热温度层，加入相同的小扰动，看它能否长大。: Start from a conductive temperature layer with a small prescribed disturbance. Can it grow?
下热上冷时，温度扰动与浮力耦合，逐渐形成上升暖流。: With warmth below, temperature disturbances couple to buoyancy and grow into rising currents.
上升必须有回流；亮点和染料由同一个封闭速度场搬运。: Rising flow needs a return path. Tracers and dye follow the same closed-cell velocity field.
保留相同温差，去掉浮力耦合：传导仍在，携热流动消失。: Keep the temperature difference and remove buoyancy: conduction remains, but circulating heat transport disappears.
只交换冷热板，扰动不再长大；热从上方主要靠传导向下走。: Swap the warm and cool plates. The disturbance decays, and heat travels mainly downward by conduction.
把两板调到同温，余热与惯性不会瞬间消失，流动逐步衰减。: Set both plates to one temperature. Stored heat and motion remain briefly, then the flow decays.
加密网格仍得到对流，但数值会变化；本演示不测量临界阈值。: A finer grid still gives convection, with different numbers. We do not measure an onset threshold.
正在重建所选时刻；画面读数对应当前已完成的计算。: Reconstructing the requested time. The displayed field and readings share the last completed state.
改变一个条件，在相同模型时间比较流动与携热。: Change one condition and compare flow and heat transport at the same model time.
中截面平均的向上携热通量；负号表示向下。: Mean advective heat flux at mid-height. Negative means downward.
网格和迎风格式带来数值耗散；读数不是实验测量。: Upwinding adds numerical dissipation. Values are computed.
人为指定的小温度扰动幅度为 0.02，没有随机种子。: The prescribed temperature disturbance has amplitude 0.02. No random seed is used.
t* = 24 起，两块恒温板均设为 0.5。: From t* = 24, both plates are held at 0.5.
本章无横向扰动；接下来从导热温度层重新开始。: No sideways disturbance here. Next, restart from a conductive temperature layer.
四壁不穿透、自由滑移；侧壁绝热，温度与时间均无量纲。: Impermeable, free-slip walls; insulated sides. Temperature and time are dimensionless.
这是闭合二维 Boussinesq 教学网格：密度变化只进入浮力项。玻璃外观是示: This closed 2D Boussinesq teaching grid includes density changes only in buoyancy. The glass appearance is illustrative: the velocity boundary is free-slip, not the no-slip condition of real glass.
单元内热量和染料由同一无散度面速度输运。温度板固定，侧壁绝热；流函数在四壁为零。: Heat and dye share the same divergence-free face velocities. Plate temperatures are prescribed, side walls insulated, and streamfunction zero at every wall. Tracers follow the calculated velocity, not preset circular paths.
宽高比 1.5；标准网格 30 × 20，热扩散系数 0.01，动量扩散系数默认: The aspect ratio is 1.5, the base grid 30 × 20, thermal diffusivity 0.01 and default momentum diffusivity 0.02. Time and readings are dimensionless, not seconds, Celsius temperatures or watts for a particular cup of water.
一阶迎风输运会产生额外数值扩散；物理黏性与数值耗散不可混为一谈。模型不测量临界: First-order upwind transport adds numerical diffusion; physical viscosity and numerical dissipation are different. This model does not measure critical Rayleigh numbers or predict real 3D turbulence, boiling or a free surface.
Worker 不可用，正在分块重建同一模型；不是另一个预设动画。: Worker unavailable: bounded chunks reconstruct the same solver, not a preset animation.
重播与跳转从固定初态和时间步重建；后台与离屏由共用播放器暂停。Canvas 不可: Replay and seeking reconstruct fixed initial conditions and timesteps. The shared player pauses in the background and offscreen. If Canvas is unavailable, SVG renders the same computed fields.

封闭流体格点计算：颜色为温度，示踪点跟随同一速度场。: Computed closed fluid cell: colors show temperature and tracers follow the same velocity field.

阳光怎样走完一条电路？: How does sunlight complete a circuit?
一束光照上硅片，为什么能让外面的电流流动？: How can light on silicon drive current through an outside circuit?
跟住一个被吸收的光子，穿过结区与闭合回路，再用实际求解的 I–V 曲线核算输出与: Follow an absorbed photon through a junction and closed circuit, then solve the I–V curve to account for output and losses.
越过带隙才可能激发电荷对；多出来的光子能量先变成热。: A photon must cross the bandgap to excite a pair; excess photon energy becomes heat.
一对等量异号电荷同时出现；结区电场让电子与空穴向相反方向移动。: Equal opposite charges appear together. The junction field separates electrons and holes.
电子沿接点、导线与负载返回；空穴留在电池内，闭合路径才持续输出。: Electrons return through contacts, wire and load. Holes stay in the cell; sustained output needs a closed path.
负载直线与 I–V 曲线的交点，决定真实电流、电压与输出功率。: The load line meets the I–V curve at the actual current, voltage and power.
开路有电压却没有外电流；短路有电流却没有负载电压。两者输出都为零。: An open circuit has no external current; a short has no load voltage. Both deliver zero power.
增加照度提高光生电流；暗态的被动负载没有可用输出。: More irradiance raises photocurrent. In darkness, a passive load receives no power.
先减少被收集的电荷，再增大串联电阻：复合与发热是不同损失。: First reduce collection, then increase series resistance: recombination and heating are different losses.
标记数量不是电流大小。稳态电流由下方的单二极管模型计算。: Marker count is not current. The single-diode model below calculates steady current.
固定 800 nm 的一次吸收事件。路径按阶段慢放，不表示微观输运速度或全部光子: One absorption event at a fixed 800 nm. Paths are slowed by stage; they do not represent microscopic speeds or every photon's fate.
同样的入射瓦数，不等于同样的光子数。这里只显示能否激发一对电荷；实际吸收与收集比: Equal incident watts do not mean equal photon counts. This view shows pair eligibility; the energy ledger accounts for absorption and collection fractions.
96 个相同串联电池的公开拟合参数，换算为一个等效电池。三能段光谱、4% 反射和: Public fitted parameters for 96 identical series cells, scaled to one equivalent cell. Three spectral bands, 4% reflection and 90% above-gap absorption are teaching assumptions, not measured spectra.
结电压能量差是带边能量与结电压自由能之间的剩余项，不是实测热分布。模型不包含反向: The junction-voltage energy gap is the residual between band-edge energy and junction free energy, not a measured heat map. Reverse breakdown, bypass diodes and partial module shading are excluded.
逐个光子的带隙门槛与热化能量: Individual photon bandgap thresholds and thermalization energy
太阳能电池层截面与连续外电路: Solar-cell layer section and connected external circuit
由单二极管方程求解的电流电压曲线与负载交点: Solved single-diode current-voltage curve and load intersection
电流源、二极管和漏电支路共用同一对节点: Photocurrent, diode and leakage share the same two circuit nodes
两种零输出: Two ways to get zero power
这组硅电池参数中，升温略增短路电流，却降低开路电压与最大功率。: For this silicon model, warming slightly raises short-circuit current but lowers open-circuit voltage and maximum power.
把一把钥匙放到公开处: Put one key in public view
两种指数，从哪里来: Where the two exponents come from
把幂拆开，算出密文: Split the power to compute the ciphertext
私人指数把消息带回来: The private exponent brings the message back
零和不互素的数，也要回来: Zero and shared factors must work too
算得回来，不代表守得住: A round-trip is not a security guarantee
公开 n 和 e；发件人可算出密文，d 由收件人保管。: Publish n and e so anyone can compute ciphertext. The recipient keeps d private.
由不同素数构造 n，再求 e 在模 λ 下的逆元 d。: Build n from distinct primes, then find d as the inverse of e modulo λ.
消息只能取 0 到 n−1；mod 表示余数，不是普通除法。: Messages range from 0 to n−1. The mod operation returns a remainder.
指数 7 = 1 + 2 + 4；平方得余数，选中后逐项乘入。: The exponent 7 is 1 + 2 + 4. Square, reduce, and multiply the selected terms.
同一密文改用指数 23；跳过 8，最后恢复消息 42。: Apply exponent 23 to the ciphertext. Skip power 8 and recover message 42.
逐个检查边界与不互素消息；两边素数的余数都必须恢复。: Check boundaries and shared factors. Both prime remainders must return correctly.
不填充的 RSA 是确定性的；小消息可以逐个公开猜测。: Unpadded RSA is deterministic. Small messages can be guessed using the public key.
现代 RSA 加密需要安全填充；混合方案用随机密钥保护内容。: Modern RSA encryption needs secure padding. Hybrid schemes protect content with a random key.
选消息与一组小钥匙，逐项观察平方和乘入。: Choose a message and a tiny key pair. Inspect each square and multiplication.
整份的 n 去掉，只保留余数。: Remove whole multiples of n and keep the remainder.
请输入 0 到 {0} 的十进制整数，不自动取模。: Enter a decimal integer from 0 to {0}. Out-of-range values are not wrapped.
这是加密原理，不是签名演示，也不提供真实加密。: This explains encryption, not signing. No real encryption is provided.
小素数与私钥刻意公开，仅用于看清算法。: Tiny primes and private values are exposed for teaching only.
范围 0…{0}；这里只处理整数，不接收秘密文字。: Range 0…{0}. Integers only; do not enter secret text.
展开钥匙与运算规则: Inspect the key and calculation rules
所有乘法都用整数精确计算；播放时间不是破解或运算耗时。: Multiplication uses exact integers. Film timing is not computation or attack time.
安全的 RSA 加密使用 OAEP 等规范方案；本教具没有填充、随机源或导出功能: Secure RSA encryption uses a standardized scheme such as OAEP. This lesson has no padding, randomness or export function.
平方得到的幂及其余数: Powers and remainders from repeated squaring
乘入这一项，留下余数: Multiply this term; keep the remainder
指数没有这一项，累积值不变: This power is unused; keep the accumulator
每次平方只留余数；指数选中的项才乘入。: Reduce after each square. Multiply only the powers selected by the exponent.
公开它们的乘积；真实系统要保护素因子。: Publish their product. Real systems protect the prime factors.
私钥的指数，不是普通倒数: A modular inverse, not a fraction
乘积除以 λ 的余数为 1。: The product leaves remainder 1 modulo λ.
任何人都能用它算出密文。: Anyone can use this to compute ciphertext.
私人指数 d 留在收件人一侧。: The private exponent d stays with the recipient.
零余数仍回到零: A zero remainder returns to zero
两边余数都吻合，范围内的消息唯一。: Matching both remainders identifies one message in the allowed range.
不互素也能恢复；不能只用互素情形来证明。: Shared factors still work. A proof cannot cover only coprime messages.
本模型完整整数域的往返核对: Round-trips checked across this model’s entire integer domain
相同消息，相同密文：这里没有随机填充。: Same message, same ciphertext: there is no randomized padding here.
猜中 42，密文吻合；小域里的秘密已经失守。: Guess 42 matches the ciphertext. This tiny domain has given up the secret.
只用公开的 n 和 e，逐个测试候选消息。: Test candidate messages using only the public n and e.
收件人的公钥保护 K: The recipient’s public key protects K
同一 K 恢复内容: Recover content with the same K
先确认公钥属于谁；加密本身不证明发件人身份。: Verify whose public key it is. Encryption alone does not authenticate the sender.
公钥可以公开，消息怎样只让收件人解开？: How can a public key help keep a message private?
把 42 送出去，再用另一种指数带回来。: Send 42 out, then bring it back with a different exponent.
用刻意不安全的小整数走完 RSA：造钥匙、求逆元、平方乘法、加密与解密，并亲眼看: Follow RSA with deliberately insecure small integers: key construction, modular inversion, repeated squaring, encryption and decryption, then see the model’s limits.
逻辑门：电压如何变成零和一: Logic gates: how voltage becomes zero and one
晶体管怎样把输入变成逻辑，为什么还需要时间？: How do transistors turn inputs into logic, and why does it take time?
沿 CMOS 的上拉与下拉通路，观察电容电压、传播延迟和翻转能量。: Follow CMOS pull-up and pull-down paths through capacitor voltage, propagation delay and switching energy.
输出电压穿过低电平、未定义区域和高电平；曲线来自同一个 RC 模型: Output voltage passes through low, undefined and high regions; the curves use the same RC model
从晶体管通路到逻辑电平的 CMOS 电路: CMOS circuits from transistor paths to logic levels
检查输入变化后的电压: Inspect voltage after an input change
沟道实线表示接通，栅极与沟道绝缘: Solid channels are on; gates are insulated
先设定起始和切换后的输入，再拖动时间。逻辑目标会改变，电容电压保持连续；X 区域: Set the initial and new inputs, then move time. The logic target changes while capacitor voltage stays continuous; X is not a reliable 0 or 1.
真实 MOSFET 取决于栅源电压与器件曲线。这里把它们简化成互补开关，省略漏电: Real MOSFET behavior depends on gate-to-source voltage and device curves. This complementary-switch model omits leakage, conduction overlap and internal-node capacitance; 0.5 VDD is a model boundary, not a universal device threshold.
从电源、晶体管沟道到输出电容和地的完整 CMOS 网络；栅极控制线与沟道绝缘: Complete CMOS network from supply through transistor channels to the output capacitor and ground; gate control wires are insulated from the channels
两级反相器：第一级输出以连续导线连接第二级的两个绝缘栅极: Two inverters: a continuous wire connects the first output to both insulated gates of the second stage
低输入接通上拉路径: A low input opens the pull-up path
A 为 0，上拉给电容充电；输出电压逐渐升高。: With A at 0, the pull-up charges the capacitor and the output rises.
高输入接通下拉路径: A high input opens the pull-down path
A 为 1，上拉断开，下拉让电容连续放电。: With A at 1, the pull-up opens and the capacitor discharges through the pull-down.
两个下拉串联；任一个没有接通，输出就不能沿它们放电。: The pull-down devices are in series; either open switch breaks the discharge path.
或非门：一条下拉就够: NOR needs only one pull-down path
下拉改成并联，任一高输入都能拉低输出。: Parallel pull-down paths let either high input pull the output low.
X 表示不能保证的逻辑读数；电容电压仍有确定数值。: X marks an unguaranteed logic reading; the capacitor voltage remains definite.
10 fF 换成 40 fF，电阻不变，半电压时间增加到四倍。: Changing 10 fF to 40 fF quadruples half-voltage time at the same resistance.
变化沿两级电路传播: A transition travels through two stages
Y₁ 穿过模型界线后，第二级才开始改变 Y₂。: Only after Y₁ crosses the model boundary does the second stage begin changing Y₂.
充电把能量分给电容与热，随后放电把储能也变成热。: Charging divides energy between storage and heat; discharging turns the stored part into heat.
石墨与 LFP 储存锂；湿润的隔膜把两极分开。: Graphite and LFP host lithium; the wet separator keeps the electrodes apart.
放电时，锂离子走内部，电子绕过隔膜走外部。: During discharge, ions travel inside; electrons take the external route.
同一对示踪点走两条路，电子不穿过隔膜。: The same tracers take separate paths. Electrons never cross the separator.
每转移一份锂，就有匹配的电荷经过外部电路。: Lithium transfer is matched by charge through the external circuit.
电流增大，内阻压降立刻增加，极化随后累积。: More current causes an immediate resistive drop, followed by polarization.
电压回升了，SOC 没有增加；极化储能正在散为热。: Voltage recovers without adding charge. Polarization energy becomes heat.
充电源提供能量，同一组示踪点沿原路返回。: The charger supplies energy as the same tracers retrace their paths.
到达可用容量端点，模型控制器断流，停止继续充入。: At the usable capacity limit, the model controller stops charging.
电能在储存、外部功和内部热之间结算。: Account for energy stored, delivered and dissipated inside the cell.
虚线是同一 SOC 的开路近似。没有凭空补回电量。: The dashed line is the open-circuit approximation at the same SOC. No charge is replenished.
Wh 是能量，Ah 是电荷容量。这里都从同一状态积分。: Wh measures energy; Ah measures charge capacity. Both follow the same state.
金色 Li⁺，蓝色 e⁻；示踪点不表示真实粒子数量或速度。: Gold: Li⁺. Blue: e⁻. Tracers do not represent particle counts or actual speeds.
每次改动都从所选初态重建。休息模式先施加 120 秒放电，再断流。: Changes reconstruct from the selected initial state. Rest mode first applies 120 seconds of discharge, then removes current.
采用石墨 / 磷酸铁锂体系：负极 LiₓC₆，正极 LiᵧFePO₄。平均化学计: The scoped chemistry is graphite / lithium iron phosphate: LiₓC₆ and LiᵧFePO₄. Average stoichiometries are x = 0.05 + 0.9 SOC and y = 0.95 − 0.9 SOC, with matched host capacities.
SOC 的零点和满点是本模型的可用窗口；零点仍有锂。正常石墨储锂是嵌入宿主，不是: Zero and full SOC delimit the modeled usable window; lithium remains at zero. Normal graphite storage is intercalation into a host, not a metallic-lithium negative electrode.
电解液与隔膜孔道传导离子，电子经电极导电网络、铜和铝集流体及外部装置传输。局部电: Electrolyte and separator pores carry ions. Electrons move through conducting electrode networks, copper and aluminum collectors, and the external device. Local electroneutrality, salt-anion motion and electrolyte inventory are averaged. Reversible tracer paths are teaching mappings, not molecular trajectories, concentration fields or electron drift calculations.
用一个随 SOC 变化的教学开路电压源、串联内阻和一个被动 RC 支路表示端口行: Terminal behavior uses an authored SOC-dependent voltage source, series resistance and one passive RC branch. The voltage curve is not fitted to a commercial cell. RC represents an equivalent polarization state, not a literal capacitor inside the cell.
可逆储能由 Q∫U dSOC 计算；暂存项为 Cₚp²/2，内部热功率为 I²R: Reversible energy is Q∫U dSOC; equivalent polarization storage is Cₚp²/2. Internal heat power is I²R₀ + p²/Rₚ. Temperature is fixed and heat is passed to the surroundings. Entropic heat, aging, side reactions, plating, phase transformations and spatial diffusion are omitted.
示例使用 1 Ah、R₀ = 0.04 Ω、Rₚ = 0.03 Ω、时间常数 4: The example uses 1 Ah, R₀ = 0.04 Ω, Rₚ = 0.03 Ω and a 45-second time constant. The controller stops at SOC endpoints or illustrative voltage limits. It does not implement a real constant-current/constant-voltage charger or prescribe charging settings.
电芯厚度、孔和粒子被放大以便观察，结构不是制造图。影片加速物理时间，所有章与拖动: Layer thickness, pores and particles are exaggerated for inspection, not manufacturing. Physical time is accelerated; every chapter and seek position reconstructs directly from shared progress.

两个宿主的平均含锂比例，总锂量守恒: Average lithium fractions in the two hosts, with total lithium conserved
开路电压与端电压，差值由内阻和极化决定: Open-circuit and terminal voltage differ through resistance and polarization

锂储存在宿主里，隔膜保持两极分开。: Lithium sits in hosts; the separator keeps the electrodes apart.
锂离子向内穿行，电子经过外部负载。: Ions travel internally; electrons pass through the external load.
同一组身份保持不变，路径不会跨错材料。: Tracer identities stay fixed, and their paths respect the materials.
两极含锂比例一减一增，总量保持不变。: One host loses lithium as the other gains it; total inventory stays fixed.
内阻立刻降压，极化随后变化，内部持续发热。: Resistance acts immediately; polarization follows, with internal heat loss.
断流后 SOC 不变，极化储能释放为热。: At zero current, SOC stays fixed while polarization energy becomes heat.
提供能量，沿原路返回: Supply energy and reverse the paths
充电源做功，锂回到石墨，电子方向也反转。: The charger does work as lithium returns to graphite and electrons reverse.
容量端点触发断流，能量账目始终闭合。: The usable capacity limit stops current, while energy accounting stays balanced.

跟随格雷厄姆静止式擒纵的一枚齿尖，看锁定、冲量与放行怎样把持续供能分成节拍。: Follow a tooth through a Graham deadbeat escapement: locking, impulse and release turn a steady drive into counted beats.
轮子想转，摆在把关: The wheel wants to turn; the pendulum gates it
锁住轮子，摆仍在走: The wheel rests while the pendulum moves
齿尖滑过冲量面: The tooth crosses the impulse face
出口瓦接住下一步: The exit pallet catches the next step
一次往返，恰好一个齿距: One full swing, one tooth pitch
摆变长，放行的节拍变慢: A longer pendulum releases more slowly
重锤供能，钟摆定拍: The weight supplies energy; the pendulum sets the beat
亲手检查锁定、冲量与节拍: Inspect the lock, impulse and beat

30 齿、7.5 齿距跨距；两侧锁面以锚轴为圆心，冲量面连接同一齿尖圆上的释放端: Thirty teeth and a 7.5-pitch span. Both locking faces are centred on the anchor arbor; each impulse face joins contact endpoints on the same tooth-tip circle. Tooth shape, lock, impulse and drop share this geometry.
主机构规定小角摆的运动；跌落采用有限时长的加速曲线，不求解轮系惯量、冲击或摩擦。: The mechanism prescribes small-angle pendulum motion. Drop uses a finite acceleration curve; train inertia, impact and friction are not solved. The weight drives a demonstration drum directly; a real clock train is omitted.
能量对照另用线性小角摆：质量 0.20 kg，阻尼系数 γ = 0.025 s⁻: The separate energy comparison uses a linear pendulum: mass 0.20 kg, damping rate γ = 0.025 s⁻¹, and specified work at centre crossings. It explains loss replacement, not this escapement’s torque, efficiency or timing error.
机构尺寸以展示单位 u 表示，摆长以 m 表示。模型的摆杆按有效摆长同步改变；这: Mechanism dimensions use display units u; pendulum length uses metres. The displayed rod changes with effective length. These are teaching proportions, not manufacturing dimensions.
同一接触几何的二维剖面: Two-dimensional section of the same contact geometry
每次完整往返：前进一齿: Each full swing advances one tooth
同一起点：自由衰减与定量补能: Same starting point: decay and fixed-work impulses
相同经过时间，改变有效摆长: Same elapsed time, different effective lengths
锁面与锚轴同心: Lock and anchor share a centre
重锤拉动卷筒；擒纵轮被两块擒纵瓦交替拦住。: The weight pulls the drum; two pallets alternately hold the escape wheel.
锁面是以锚轴为圆心的圆弧：摆动时，齿尖停在原处。: The locking arc is centred on the anchor arbor, so the tooth stays put as the anchor swings.
齿尖越过锁角，沿平面冲量面推进；随后进入短暂跌落。: The tooth passes the locking corner, drives along the impulse plane, then briefly drops free.
出口瓦先锁住轮子，待摆返回，再从另一方向传递冲量。: The exit pallet locks first, then delivers an impulse on the returning swing.
每半次往返放行一次；完整往返后，30 齿轮前进 12°。: There is one release per half-swing; a full swing advances this 30-tooth wheel by 12°.
同一起点与阻尼：自由摆衰减；理想中点补能维持能量范围。: Same start and damping: the free swing decays; ideal centre impulses sustain its energy range.
相同计时窗口里，较长的摆周期更长，累计放行更少。: Over the same time window, a longer pendulum has a longer period and fewer releases.
锁定限制轮的推进；冲量补偿损失；摆长决定近似周期。: Lock limits the wheel, impulse replaces losses, and length sets the approximate period.

内部页保存分隔键与子页指针；按键值、行号的字典序选路。: Internal pages hold separators and child pointers. Route by key, then row ID.

同一结果：全扫触及 6 个堆页；索引触及 4 个索引页和 1 个堆页。: Same result: scan touches 6 heap pages; lookup touches 4 index pages and 1 heap page.
查询 38 到 47：先定位，再沿叶页链接前进；三个 42 都保留各自行号。: For 38 through 47, locate the start and follow leaf links. All three 42s keep their row IDs.
叶页最多 3 项；第 4 项触发分裂，右页最小项复制到父页。: A leaf holds 3 entries. A fourth splits it; copy the right minimum into the parent.
子页指针也会撑满父页；内部页上推分隔键，根分裂后所有叶子统一加深一层。: Child pointers can overflow a parent. Promote internal separators; a root split adds one level to every leaf.
读全部 37 行时：索引触及 27 个不同页，全扫只需 10 个堆页；选择取决于: For all 37 rows, the index touches 27 distinct pages; the scan needs 10 heap pages. Workload matters.
分裂的局部快照；提交后整树平衡。: Local split snapshot; the committed tree is balanced.
微型页：I 为索引，H 为堆；计数不是耗时。: Toy pages: I = index, H = heap. Counts are not time.
r0 排在所有真实行号之前。: r0 precedes every real row ID.
固定黏度、半径；共用标准化噪声作对照。: Fixed viscosity and radius; matched standardized noise.
同一温度。黏度增大或球变大，长时间 D 都下降。: Same temperature. More viscosity or a larger sphere lowers D.
热浴冲量 + 阻力冲量 = 动量变化；不是瞬时白噪声力。: Bath impulse + drag impulse = momentum change; not an instantaneous white-noise force.
T = 0 是经典模型极限；保留初速度，不代表液体能冷到零开尔文。: T = 0 is a classical model limit with retained initial velocity, not a liquid at absolute zero.
金色：带惯性；蓝色虚线：同一热浴的过阻尼极限。: Gold: inertia. Blue dashes: the overdamped limit driven by the same bath.
深色菱形是平均位置，不是一颗真的粒子。: The dark diamond is the mean position, not a real particle.
64 次独立重复。圆圈是理论均方根尺度，不是围墙。: 64 independent trials. The ring marks the theoretical RMS scale, not a wall.
轨迹连接离散观测点；视野边缘不是物理边界。: Lines join discrete observations. The view has no physical walls.
只放大质心位移；圆点大小不代表粒子半径。: Only centroid displacement is magnified; dot size is not particle radius.
固定种子可重建同一轨迹；改变参数会重算整次实验。温度与黏度独立设置，不是某种液体: A fixed seed reconstructs the same path. Parameters restart the trial. Temperature and viscosity are independent inputs, not a real liquid’s temperature curve.
采用稀悬浮液中无滑移球体的经典、各向同性 Langevin 模型。流体无整体流动: A classical isotropic Langevin model represents a no-slip sphere in a dilute suspension. There is no mean flow, external force, wall or particle interaction. The image projects two coordinates of three-dimensional motion.
质量按密度 1050 kg/m³ 与球体体积计算。初速度取热平衡高斯分布；零温衰: Mass uses a density of 1050 kg/m³ and the sphere’s volume. Initial velocities are thermal Gaussians; the zero-temperature chapter retains its initial velocity. Free-space positions have no normalizable equilibrium distribution, although velocities can remain at thermal equilibrium.
流体附加质量、流体记忆、有限分子碰撞时间和真实显微镜噪声均未模拟。纳秒镜头解释这: Fluid added mass, hydrodynamic memory, finite molecular collision times and instrument noise are omitted. The nanosecond shot explains this ideal model; it does not reproduce a real liquid’s ultrashort-time experiment.
采用位置与速度的联合高斯精确转移。噪声按种子与样本序号寻址，固定观测点之间直线插: Position and velocity use exact joint Gaussian transitions. Seed and sample index address the noise. Linear interpolation joins fixed observations; it is not a resolved microscopic trajectory. White noise is used only through integrals or statistics.
参数对照共用标准化噪声，便于比较尺度；64 次统计使用独立种子。只平均所示 x、: Parameter comparisons share standardized noise to reveal scale changes; the 64-trial statistics use independent seeds. Only the displayed x and y coordinates enter the MSD, giving a factor of 4 rather than the three-dimensional 6.

没有水流，粒子为什么还在走？: Why does a particle move in a still fluid?
随机的单条轨迹，怎样留下稳定的统计规律？: How can one random path reveal a reliable statistical law?
跟随一颗微球，从热浴冲量与惯性记忆走到 Stokes–Einstein 关系，分: Follow a microsphere from thermal impulses and inertial memory to the Stokes–Einstein relation, separating a single path, mean-square displacement and mean position.
没有整体水流，热浴中的微球仍留下不规则轨迹。: A sphere leaves an irregular path even without a mean fluid flow.
一个采样窗内，热浴与阻力的冲量共同改变动量。: Over a sampling window, bath and drag impulses change momentum.
关闭热噪声后，已有速度按时间常数 τ 衰减。: With thermal noise off, the initial velocity decays on the timescale τ.
远大于 τ 时，惯性轨迹与同一热浴的过阻尼描述几乎重合。: Far beyond τ, inertial and overdamped paths nearly coincide for the same bath.
固定黏度和半径，温度越高，D 越大。: At fixed viscosity and radius, higher temperature gives a larger D.
黏度乘三，D 变成三分之一；半径乘二，D 减半。: Triple viscosity divides D by three; double radius halves D.
单条位移平方会起落；独立重复的平均接近理论均方位移。: One squared displacement rises and falls; independent-trial averages approach the theoretical MSD.
平均位置不是一条命运: The mean is not a particle
平均位置接近起点，粒子的典型离开距离却持续扩大。: The mean stays near the origin while the typical displacement grows.
没有水流，颜色为什么还会散开？: Why does color spread without a current?

从浓度曲线计算净通量、局部收支和扩散宽度，比较扩散系数、长度与边界。: Compute flux, local mass balance and spreading width from concentration, then compare diffusivity, length and boundaries.
浓度带与同一扩散解的截面曲线；箭头表示净通量，不是流体速度。: Concentration ribbon and profile from the same diffusion solution. Arrows indicate net flux, not fluid velocity.
移动时间或改变条件，查看同一初态的浓度解。这里没有整体平流。: Change time or a condition to reconstruct the concentration from the same initial state. There is no bulk advection.
新边界实验：端点浓度固定，介质仍无整体流动。: New boundary experiment: fixed endpoint concentrations, with no bulk flow.
等比例初态、各自总量为 1；长度与浓度共用标尺。: Geometrically scaled initial shapes, amount 1 each. Shared length and concentration scales.
相同初态、质量、长度和时刻；只改变 D。: Same initial field, amount, length and time. Only D changes.
虚线是均匀极限；短斜线为早期 2Dt 参照。: Dashed line: uniform limit. Short slope: early 2Dt reference.
A 与 B 分别守恒；颜色仅为浓度的示意映射。: A and B each keep their amount. Color is an illustrative concentration map.
选区为 0.55L–0.85L；净增加率 = 左端通量 − 右端通量。: Region: 0.55L–0.85L. Accumulation = left flux − right flux.
箭头仅示净通量方向，不是分子轨迹或流体速度。: Arrows show net flux direction, not molecular paths or fluid velocity.
虚线保留初始曲线；颜色带是横截面均匀的一维浓度。: Dashed curve: initial profile. Concentration is uniform across each cross-section.
介质静止，截面积取 1，浓度在横截面内均匀。求解 ∂c/∂t = D∂²c/∂x: The medium is still, cross-sectional area is 1 and concentration is uniform across each section. The model solves ∂c/∂t = D∂²c/∂x² with J = −D∂c/∂x. There is no advection, reaction or individual molecular path.
封闭端点满足零梯度、零通量。初始脉冲是归一化的 sin⁸(πx/L)，用四个余弦: Sealed ends have zero gradient and zero flux. The initial pulse is normalized sin⁸(πx/L), evolved exactly with four cosine modes. It is not a truncated square pulse or a time-stepping scheme.
混合采用两种不反应、扩散系数相同的稀标记：初态分别为 (1 ± 0.95cos(: Mixing uses two nonreacting dilute labels with equal D. Their initial fields are (1 ± 0.95cos(πx/L))/L, each with total amount 1. A blended color does not mean lost material.
固定浓度实验重新从 1 − x/L − 0.2sin(πx/L) 开始，左端始终: The fixed-concentration experiment restarts from 1 − x/L − 0.2sin(πx/L). The left end remains at 1 and the right at 0. Reservoirs can exchange material, so the amount inside need not stay constant.
D、长度、时间和浓度均为无量纲教学参数。图像亮度来自浓度的示意吸收映射，不是实际: D, length, time and concentration use authored dimensionless units. Brightness comes from an illustrative absorption map, not a measured dye spectrum. Length comparisons scale the initial shape geometrically while preserving its amount.
方差的早期增加接近 2Dt，封闭边界逐渐改变这条关系，最终趋于 L²/12。宏观: The early variance increase approaches 2Dt. Sealed boundaries change that relation and the variance approaches L²/12. Decaying concentration variations do not mean molecules slow or stop. Microscopic reversible dynamics are not solved.
任意时刻直接由初态的指数衰减模态重建；没有累积帧历史。共享播放器负责暂停、重播、: Every time is reconstructed directly from decaying initial modes, without accumulated frame history. The shared player handles pause, replay, offscreen/background suspension and reduced motion.

封闭带里的峰变矮、两侧变宽，但曲线下的总量不变。: The peak falls and spreads in a sealed strip, while the amount under the curve stays constant.
同一截面处，浓度坡度变缓，净通量也随之减弱。: At one fixed section, a gentler concentration slope produces a smaller net flux.
局部先积累，再向外输送；整条封闭带的总量始终守恒。: A region first accumulates material, then loses it, while the sealed strip conserves its total.
方差最初近似线性增加，随后受到封闭边界限制，趋向均匀分布。: Variance initially grows almost linearly, then levels toward the uniform distribution inside the boundaries.
同样的初态和时刻，D 加倍相当于基准组走过两倍模型时间。: With the same initial state, doubling D gives the baseline profile at twice the model time.
长度加倍、初态同比放大时，达到同样相对平滑程度需要四倍时间。: Doubling length with a geometrically scaled initial shape requires four times the time for equal relative smoothing.
A、B 的浓度逐渐重叠，各自总量不变，总浓度也保持不变。: The A and B profiles overlap while each amount, and their total concentration, remain unchanged.
固定浓度储库允许交换物质；最终曲线稳定，净扩散通量仍然存在。: Fixed-concentration reservoirs exchange material; the final profile becomes steady while diffusive flux continues.

跟随同一批分组，观察最短路径、排队、TTL、故障收敛与接收重排。: Follow the same packets through shortest paths, queues, TTL, failure convergence and receiver reordering.
到零就丢弃；目的主机不再转发: Discard at zero; the destination does not forward
拖动取样时间，检查同一批分组的下一跳、队列和接收顺序。数据分组为 1200 字节: Move sample time to inspect the same packets, queues and arrival order. Data packets are 1200 bytes; diagram positions represent packet state, not geographical distance to scale.
这是单域链路状态教学模型：确定性最短路径、FIFO、逐跳 TTL 与有限速率控制: This single-area link-state teaching model uses deterministic shortest paths, FIFO, per-hop TTL and finite-rate control messages. It omits full OSPF, ICMP, retransmission and TCP congestion control; receiver slots illustrate ordered application delivery only.
分组网络：S 经 A、B、C 路由到 R，实线是数据链路，紫色虚线标识拓扑更新: Packet network: S routes through A, B and C to R; solid lines are data links and violet dashed lines identify topology updates
分组只选择下一跳: Each router chooses a next hop
目的地保持 R，每个路由器依据自己的表选择下一跳。: The destination stays R; each router consults its own table for the next hop.
两次已收敛网络只改变 B–R 的代价，最短路径随之改变。: Two converged networks differ only in B–R cost, changing the least-cost path.
同一出口一次发送一个分组；后来者先占等待位。: An output serializes one packet at a time; later packets wait in its queue.
每次路由器转发先减一；TTL 到零，分组被丢弃。: A router decrements TTL before forwarding; zero means the packet is discarded.
故障先被邻居发现: A neighbor notices the failure first
B–R 中断时，链路上的 P1 丢失；其他路由器尚未同时获知。: When B–R fails, P1 on that link is lost; remote routers do not know immediately.
B 先改道，C 仍用旧表；短暂绕圈直到新拓扑安装完成。: B changes first while C still uses its old table, creating a temporary loop until the update is installed.
队列满了，分组会被丢弃: A full queue drops arriving packets
相同十个分组、相同发送时刻：更多等待位减少丢弃，但不会加快出口。: The same ten packets and release times: more waiting slots reduce drops but do not speed up the output.
先到达，不一定先交付: Arrival order is not delivery order
较晚的 P4 走新恢复的快路先到；应用顺序槽等待缺口补齐。: Later P4 takes the newly restored fast route and arrives first; the application waits for missing sequence positions.

一股油，怎样举起一斗土？: How does oil lift a bucket of earth?
跟随液压油进入油缸，再沿动臂、斗杆和铲斗连杆，看压力、流量与力矩怎样共同决定动作: Follow oil into a sectioned boom cylinder, then out through the boom, stick and bucket linkage. Pressure, flow and leverage each answer a different question.

载荷增加，所需压力上升。: A heavier load requires more pressure.
同样面积下，流量越大，活塞越快。: For the same area, more flow means more speed.
铲斗连杆闭合，把油缸动作传到斗齿。: A closed linkage carries motion to the bucket.

本文选用无电池标签的 NFC-A 106 kbit/s 信号子集。固定的比特从左: This scene uses an NFC-A 106 kbit/s signal subset for a battery-free tag. Bits travel from left to right in the diagram; they are not a complete command, an identity credential or a payment transaction.
互感按等效圆环计算，电路采用稳态阻抗与固定整流效率；忽略金属、铁氧体、匝距、芯片: Mutual inductance uses equivalent circular loops.
